outcome: Actual cesarean section without clinical indications
cohort: 4606 women before or in early pregnancy, recruited from 2013 to 2016 in the Shanghai Birth Cohort Study
finding: Older maternal age, lower education level, and being born in a city or township were associated with an increased risk of cesarean section without clinical indication in China.
mod_finding: Older maternal age, lower education level, and being born in a city or township were risk factors for cesarean section without clinical indication in China.
